answer: Proof of Burn establishes Sybil resistance by requiring agents to destroy native tokens to gain network influence, effectively creating a lotus of scarcity. An attacker at the ledge of bankruptcy finds the cost of generating identities prohibitive, as each new inlet of fake agents requires redundant capital incineration. This economic barrier forces identity acquisition to scale linearly with financial risk, ensuring that network control remains proportional to burned value rather than forged pseudonyms.
